project_type: Next.js 14 App Router (TypeScript) + Supabase backend. Client components use '@/lib/supabase/client'; server components and API routes use '@/lib/supabase/server' (createClient / createRouteClient) and '@/lib/supabase/admin' (createAdminClient with service-role key).
build_system: Next.js 14 with npm. No special quirks.
test_framework: vitest (npm run test). TypeScript check: npm run typecheck (tsc --noEmit).
verification_instructions: Run `npx tsc --noEmit` in c:\Users\Administrator\Nursefiti3 to check for TypeScript errors. Inspect output for zero errors on new files and report pre-existing errors separately.
environment_constraints: Windows PowerShell. Do NOT push to git — local commits only when asked. All absolute paths use c:\Users\Administrator\Nursefiti3 as root.
contribution_requirements: No new npm dependencies. Match NurseFiti teal/emerald palette. Use existing UI components: Card, Button, Badge, Spinner from @/components/ui/. 'use client' only when interactivity is required.
key_patterns: Dashboard (app/(student)/dashboard/page.tsx) is 'use client'. Banners are rendered inline in DashboardPage's JSX return, before <HeroBanner>. Admin data fetches go through /api/admin/data?type=X (admin client). New admin data types are added as new 'if (type === ...)' branches. Activity tracking: user_logins table (user_id, role, logged_in_at) and page_visits table (user_id, role, page_slug, visited_at) — both queried via createAdminClient. Badge variants: teal, amber, green, red, secondary, warning. All client components in dashboard already have 'data.student.exam_date' available as a string from state.
directory_structure: app/(student)/ — student-facing pages. app/(admin)/admin/ — all admin pages. app/api/admin/ — admin-only API routes. components/ui/ — shared UI primitives. lib/supabase/ — Supabase client factories. lib/types/ — TypeScript type definitions. supabase/migrations/ — SQL migration files.
